description.en: Reads back the outcome of a match. Every real call site in the scripts invokes it with no arguments and treats the return value as a win/loss flag; the native implementation also accepts an optional array argument, whose first two elements are then overwritten with the two teams' recorded scores.
Optional array; if given, its first two elements (index 0 and 1) are overwritten with the two teams' scores from the match result.
True on every valid call regardless of the actual match outcome (script matches are scripted to always report a win this way); null if the call was invalid.
